message: 三层混凝土框架，X向2跨；我同时要求模型既按2D平面框架又按3D空间框架分析，但未提供任何Y向跨度或宽度。请直接分析。

assertions.description: The agent must explicitly identify the mutually exclusive 2D and 3D requirements and the missing Y-direction geometry needed for a 3D model, then ask the user to choose a dimension or provide the required 3D geometry before building or analyzing. Merely asking for another missing parameter does not satisfy this criterion.
